target_claim: In the displayed computation the proof asserts f^\to \circ (f^{-1})^\to = (f \circ f^{-1})^\to = (I_S)^\to = I_{\powerset S}, i.e. that f \circ f^{-1} = I_S (and symmetrically that (f^{-1})^\to \circ f^\to = I_{\powerset T}). Under the standard composition convention (g \circ f)(x) = g(f(x)) used by the source wiki, f \circ f^{-1} is the identity on T, not on S, so the two identity subscripts are swapped: the first composite is I_{\powerset T} and the second is I_{\powerset S}.
